subject: MAP Kickoff: Marketplace onboarding & evaluation sprint (AWS + Partner)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@aws-partners.com>, partnerships@cloudbridge.com, tom.reynolds@acme-retail.com
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Marketplace onboarding & evaluation sprint (AWS + Partner)

Hi Sara / CloudBridge / Tom —

Thanks for locking time to begin the mutual action plan for the Acme Retail marketplace listing and the evaluation sprint. Short intro and goals below so we have a single reference: 

- Objective: Publish an AWS Marketplace listing for Redwood Inference with a 4-week evaluation plan for Acme Retail to validate latency and cost objectives, then sign for Dedicated capacity.
- Primary outcomes: listing + Gov compliance checklist completed, evaluation pass on perf targets, and SOW consensus (target close: 2028-03-15).

Attached: MAP_v0.1.pdf (initial milestones), EvalPlan_v1.xlsx (test matrix), SOW_redwood_draft.docx (working SOW).

Roles I’d like to confirm:
- Redwood ops owner: Sergio Alvarez (I’m cc’d for exec touchpoints)
- Marketplace / listing lead (AWS): Sara Patel
- Partner integration lead (CloudBridge): Partnerships inbox / Tom Reynolds for Acme side
- Evaluation lead (Redwood): Marissa Cole
- Solution owner (Acme): Tom Reynolds

Can everyone reply with one-line confirmations of ownership for the bullets above and any missing stakeholders (procurement/security/contact for legal)? I suggest a recurring 30-minute ops stand on Mondays starting 2028-02-20 to keep cadence.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth kickoff.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0122

Attachments: MAP_v0.1.pdf (12 pages), EvalPlan_v1.xlsx (sheet: test-matrix), SOW_redwood_draft.docx (6 pages)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Marketplace onboarding & evaluation sprint (AWS + Partner)

Vanessa — confirmed.

I’ll own Redwood-side ops and the listing artifacts (AMI/container spec, pricing SKU mapping, and runbook). Quick notes:
- I’ll add the AWS Marketplace packaging checklist to the MAP and share an updated PDF by EOD tomorrow.
- Need CloudBridge to confirm the integration point for telemetry (we plan a lightweight agent + prefix caching).
- Marissa will lead evaluation tests; I’ll coordinate infra for continuous test runs.

Agreed on Mondays 30-min cadence.

Sergio
Principal Product Ops, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Thanks Vanessa, and hello all — Sara here from AWS Partner Programs. Quick readouts from our side: 

- AWS will own the marketplace listing activation and compliance checks (tax, EULA, and metering). I’ll be the primary point for listing acceptance and fast escalations.
- Timeline looks reasonable; to hit 2028-03-15 close we need completed packaging artifacts by 2028-02-24 and the first round of perf results by 2028-03-01.
- Please add an item under the MAP for billing plan verification (metering tests).

Action items for CloudBridge / Acme: please confirm the expected peak RPS and target p99 latency for the evaluation; we’ll validate against AWS quota and limit suggestions.

Sara Patel
Sr. Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace

- Acme target: peak 1200 RPS during load windows, p99 target 180ms across the test suite.
- Evaluation team: I’ll loop in our SRE lead (Dropping him in the shared invite once Sergio sends the infra plan).
- Procurement: I’ll also share our procurement contact for SOW review (expecting comments next week).

Quick operational plan from my side:

- I updated EvalPlan_v1.xlsx with the test definitions and pass/fail thresholds (sheet: test-matrix). Key tests: startup latency, sustained throughput, cold-start impact with KV cache warmup.
- Proposed acceptance criteria: p99 <= 200ms, 95th percentile cost-per-1k-tokens <= $0.35 (we can tune batching/quantization).
- I’ll schedule the first automated perf run for 2028-02-28; results will be uploaded to the shared drive and linked in HubSpot (link in MAP).

If no objections I’ll mark the EvalPlan as version 1 and hand the infra tickets to Sergio to implement.

Marissa Cole
Lead SRE, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
